title: Soprano and piano duo gigs with Johnny Hodges
summary: Waters and the younger Johnny Hodges swapped piano and soprano at Saturday tea parties for elite Black college graduates, Hodges getting the gigs as a Boston native.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: You met Johnny Hodges in Boston.

Yeah, Johnny - now Johnny and I used to work together. Now here's what we were doing - not at his club, he was working at a club called Black and White Club, he didn't open till 12 o'clock. Now he had to have that same thing that I had, because he

was in short pants and he had to have police protection, to give him permission to work with, after hours, you know, in this club. Lamb's Club is the name of the club, up there on the - I forget exactly the street - in, anyway, it was in Roxbury. And, ah - but I used to work with Johnny in this category: they used to, every Saturday after this, afternoon, they had the elite, the negro college graduates and, you know, that type of girls, they had a club. And they had a little kind of tea party or something, every Saturday, see -

Rather, rather real very often, you know. And Johnny - it was not my gig, it was Johnny's got the gigs, don't you, because Johnny's born right on Hamilton Street in Boston there, see, and I'm a stranger, see, and we both were playing soprano saxophone, see, so in this particular case we used soprano saxophone. So we worked up something that I would play the piano and he would play the soprano saxophone, then he would play the piano and I would play the soprano saxophone. And we had that little gig covered up, see, 'cause we had, we were doing something that nobody else was doing around there. And we did that for a long time, that's my first contact with Johnny. But I used to hear him at this Lamb's Club every chance I would get to go up there, you know. And that's, Johnny was playing like a man and still in short pants, still in short pants.
